blind.description: A freestanding octagonal Gothic-style stone font or basin resting on a stepped octagonal base and flared pillar. The basin exterior is decorated with carved blind Gothic tracery arches. It is covered by a segmented circular-octagonal wooden lid composed of radiating triangular planks, fitted with a dark metallic/iron loop handle at the apex. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures of weathered stone, wood, and iron.
blind.from_above: An octagonal wheel or pie-shaped wooden disc segmented into triangular planks radiating from a central dark metallic loop handle, surrounded by a thin stone rim.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.2 feet tall (around waist height, roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.2 feet wide across the rim.
